name: front plank with arm and leg lift (push up position)
description: A high plank holding the opposite arm and leg in the air, which tests balance and core strength.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold them in line with your body for a moment.
Lower them back to the floor with control.
Switch to the other arm and leg and repeat.
